title_en: Fan Ming, Liu Xilong — Intentional Homicide and Rape Case
keywords_en: criminal; intentional homicide; rape; theft; second instance; Supreme People's Court; High People's Court; Intermediate People's Court; Beijing; natural person; criminal law; fact-finding; conviction and sentence; approval of death sentence; affirm the original judgment; gang rape; murder to silence; fabricate suicide scene; summarize trial experience
full_text_en:
Fan Ming, Liu Xilong — murder and rape case

Defendant Fan Ming, male, 18 years old, a native of Jing County, Hebei Province. Formerly a track maintenance worker at the Fengtai Track Maintenance Section of the Beijing Railway Sub-Bureau, residing at the Huangcun Railway Workers' Dormitory, Daxing County, Beijing. Arrested on June 3, 1984.

Defendant Liu Xilong, male, 17 years old (born on October 17, 1966), a native of Wuqing County, Tianjin. Formerly a temporary worker at the Beijing Long-Distance Telecommunications Equipment Factory, residing at the Huangcun Railway Workers' Dormitory, Daxing County, Beijing. Arrested on June 3, 1984.

Defendants Fan Ming and Liu Xilong premeditated the rape of their middle school classmate, Zhao Yan (17 years old), a young woman from Wanglizhuang Village, Hongxing District, Daxing County. At approximately 10:00 p.m. on May 21, 1984, Fan Ming and Liu Xilong lured Zhao Yan from her home to a sluice room on the north side of the Huangwei Highway, east of Wanglizhuang Village. Fan Ming first proposed having sexual relations with Zhao Yan, and upon her refusal, used violence to rape her. After being raped, Zhao Yan cried continuously. Fearing that Zhao Yan would report the crime, Fan Ming went outside the sluice room and conspired with Liu Xilong to strangle Zhao Yan to death in order to silence her. Liu Xilong agreed, proposing that he first rape Zhao Yan and then strangle her. After Liu Xilong raped Zhao Yan, Fan Ming violently strangled Zhao Yan's neck, causing her to lose consciousness. Thereafter, Liu Xilong suggested placing Zhao Yan on the nearby railway tracks to be run over by a train, creating the appearance that Zhao Yan had committed suicide by lying on the tracks. Subsequently, Fan Ming and Liu Xilong took Zhao Yan's wristwatch and a small amount of Renminbi, and moved the unconscious Zhao Yan onto the railway tracks near the 39-kilometer marker of the Beijing-Tianjin Railway. Minutes later, Zhao Yan was struck and crushed by a passing train, resulting in cardiac rupture and internal hemorrhaging causing death. After committing the crime, Fan Ming and Liu Xilong fled the scene and were later apprehended.

Additionally, defendant Liu Xilong, from 1982 onward, had, in concert with others and alone, stolen items including three pairs of wheelbarrow wheels, over 1,000 jin of wire rod, over 20 jin of copper wire, and 24 bottles of brandy, among other goods, from the Daxing County Feed Company Processing Plant and the Beijing Long-Distance Telecommunications Equipment Factory, with a total value of over RMB 600.

On August 11, 1984, the Beijing Intermediate People's Court tried the case in accordance with the law, finding that defendants Fan Ming and Liu Xilong had conspired and jointly committed criminal acts, constituting joint intentional crimes as stipulated in Article 22, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the PRC. Fan Ming and Liu Xilong used violence to rape a young woman in succession, committing the crime of rape under Article 139 of the Criminal Law, and should be given heavier punishment in accordance with paragraph 4 of that Article. After committing the crime of rape, Fan Ming and Liu Xilong, in order to silence the victim, strangled Zhao Yan into unconsciousness and placed her on the railway tracks, causing her death by being struck and crushed by a train, thereby committing the crime of intentional homicide under Article 132 of the Criminal Law. Furthermore, defendant Liu Xilong, in concert with others and alone, stole state property of relatively large value, committing the crime of theft under Article 151 of the Criminal Law. The criminal methods of defendants Fan Ming and Liu Xilong were cruel, and the circumstances and consequences were particularly serious; they should be severely punished according to law. At the time of committing the crime, Liu Xilong was under 18 years of age, and thus, in accordance with Article 14, paragraph 3 of the Criminal Law, his punishment could be mitigated; in accordance with Article 44 of the Criminal Law, the death penalty was not applicable. Accordingly, defendant Fan Ming was sentenced to death for the crimes of intentional homicide and rape; defendant Liu Xilong was sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve for the crimes of intentional homicide, rape, and theft. Additionally, in accordance with Article 53, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, Fan Ming and Liu Xilong were deprived of political rights for life.

After the judgment was pronounced, defendant Fan Ming, dissatisfied, appealed to the Beijing High People's Court on the ground that some of the facts determined in the judgment were inconsistent.

On September 12, 1984, the Beijing High People's Court, in accordance with Article 134, paragraph 2 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, reviewed the entire case. Following the second-instance trial, it was determined: The crimes committed by defendants Fan Ming and Liu Xilong were confirmed by physical evidence, witness testimony, conclusions of criminal technical expert evaluations, and records of crime scene inspections on file; the facts were clear, and the evidence was credible and sufficient. Fan Ming's grounds for appeal could not be sustained. The first-instance judgment correctly determined the crimes of Fan Ming and Liu Xilong, imposed appropriate sentences, and the trial procedures were lawful; the judgment should be upheld. In accordance with Article 136, item (1) of the Criminal Procedure Law, the court ruled to reject the appeal and affirm the original judgment.

The Beijing High People's Court, pursuant to the provisions of the Supreme People's Court authorizing the High People's Courts to approve certain death penalty cases, approved the judgment of the Beijing Intermediate People's Court sentencing defendant Fan Ming to death and depriving him of political rights for life; in accordance with Article 146 of the Criminal Procedure Law, it approved the judgment of the Beijing Intermediate People's Court sentencing defendant Liu Xilong to death with a two-year reprieve and depriving him of political rights for life.

At its 225th session on April 25, 1985, the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, in accordance with Article 11, paragraph 1 of the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the PRC, in summing up trial experience, considered that the first-instance judgment of the Beijing Intermediate People's Court and the second-instance ruling of the Beijing High People's Court in this case correctly applied the law, accurately determined the crimes and imposed appropriate sentences, and that the trial procedures were lawful, providing a reference for people's courts at all levels.
